description: UpdateLoadBalancer and UpdateTargetPool declare a body property `name` that shares its name with the `{name}` path parameter (the load balancer), so conversion keeps only the path label and callers cannot send the body field. STACKIT's clients send it: the Terraform provider's toUpdatePayload (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/loadbalancer/loadbalancer/resource.go, read 2026-11-01) sets Name under the comment 'Not updatable but must be present', and the CLI's ToPayloadTargetPool (stackitcloud/stackit-cli, internal/pkg/services/load-balancer/utils/utils.go, read 2026-11-01) sets the target pool's Name. Add the body field as `bodyName`, on the wire as `name`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Load balancer name in the request body. Not changeable after creation: send the same value as the path's `name`.
Target pool name in the request body. A target pool cannot be renamed: send the same value as the path's `targetPoolName`.
